summary.text: Peyton Griffee is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 26 who took office on March 25, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney who served in the U.S. Army Reserve as a Judge Advocate as of the 2024 election.

paragraphs.text: Peyton Griffee was born in Bullitt County, Kentucky.
He received a bachelor's degree from Georgetown College and a J.D. from the University of Louisville School of Law.
His career experience includes working as an attorney, and at the time of the 2024 election he served in the U.S. Army Reserve as a Judge Advocate.
Griffee won the March 19, 2024 special general election for District 26 and was elected to a full term on November 5, 2024, in both cases without an opponent on the ballot.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Economic Development & Workforce Investment, House Judiciary, House Local Government and House State Government committees.
